odeProperty.value: FUTURE JOBS: WORK HARD, DREAM BIG
Working for the future: Are You Ready?

El objetivo de esta unidad es que el alumno se familiarice con vocabulario, expresiones y fórmulas relacionadas con el mundo laboral en el idioma inglés. Igualmente se trabajarán aspectos del futuro y predicciones relacionas con los tipos de trabajos y el papel de la IA en ellos. Tareas: El alumno deberá realizar un email formal para solicitar un puesto de trabajo-cover letter ( trabajo individual) , que irá seguido de una “Mock job interview”, es decir una entrevista de trabajo que se realizará en parejas y donde el alumno podrá poner en práctica, de forma oral, lo aprendido durante la unidad. Producto Final: Como proyecto final el alumno creará un Portfolio Digital Interactivo titulado “Jobs in the Future” usando herramientas como Canva, Genially, Padlet o similar, y donde incluirá posibles trabajos en el futuro, relacionados con IA o Green Jobs, incluyendo los tipos de trabajo que imagina que habrá en 2050 y describiendo cuáles serán los requisitos para ellos.

odeComponent.htmlView:
Working for the future:  Are You Ready?

The job market is changing rapidly due to technology and globalization. In the coming years, many traditional roles might disappear, while new ones related to Artificial Intelligence and sustainability will emerge. One of the biggest challenges you will face is "adaptability." It is no longer just about what you know, but how quickly you can learn new skills in an inclusive and digital environment.

Throughout this unit, we will explore these global challenges and prepare ourselves for an exciting professional future. To succeed, you need to master specific tools that showcase your talent. First, we will learn how to write a professional cover letter and a basic text to introduce yourselves. We will also build personal portfolios to highlight your achievements. Finally, we will practice mock interviews using AI simulators and oral techniques to improve your confidence . By the end of this module, you will have the essential skills to navigate the modern working world with success. Let’s start this journey together!

odeComponent.htmlView:
Look at the different types of future forms in English. 

Practice Exercises
Exercise  1. Choose the correct option (Multiple Choice)

Look at those clouds! It (will / is going to) rain.
I (am flying / fly) to London tomorrow; I have the tickets!
The film (starts / is starting) at 9:00 PM tonight.
I'm tired. I think I (will go / am going to go) to sleep.
In 2050, people (will be able to / are able to) live on Mars.
To get the job, you (will have to / will able to) speak English.

Exercise 2. Fill in the blanks (Mixed Futures)

I _________ (travel) to Japan next summer. (Plan)
Wait! I _________ (help) you with those bags. (Decision)
The bus _________ (arrive) at 10:15 AM. (Timetable)
We _________ (have) dinner with Ben tonight. (Arrangement)
You _________ (need) a passport for the trip. (Obligation)
Humans _________ (not / be able to) breathe underwater. (Ability)


Exercise 3. Sentence Transformation (Rewrite)

It is my intention to learn French. (Use going to)
The plane departure is at 5:00 PM. (Use Present Simple)
I promise to call you later. (Use will)
It’s necessary for him to work tomorrow. (Use will have to)
A meeting with the doctor is set for Monday. (Use Present Continuous)
Is it possible for her to drive next year? (Use will be able to)

odeComponent.htmlView:
Job definitions

Colleague # The person you work with

Deadline # The final date or time to complete a task

Manager # The person who leads a team or department

Salary # The money a worker receives for their job

Meeting # A planned gathering where people discuss work

Promotion # A move to a higher position at work

Shift # The period of time a person works during the day or night

Interview # A formal conversation to evaluate a candidate for a job

Coworker # A person who works at the same company as you

Resignation # The act of leaving a job officially


ACTIVITY 1 – COMPLETE THE SENTENCES

Complete each sentence with the correct word from the box.

Colleague – Deadline – Manager – Salary – Meeting

My __________ asked me to finish the report today.

We have an important __________ at 10 a.m.

The project __________ is next Friday.

A __________ is someone you work with every day.

Her monthly __________ is very good for her age.

ACTIVITY 2 – CHOOSE THE CORRECT WORD

Choose the correct vocabulary word to complete each sentence.

I work at night, so I have a night __________.
(shift / interview)

The company offered her a __________ after two years.
(promotion / resignation)

Tomorrow I have a job __________ at a big company.
(interview / salary)

My best __________ helps me with difficult tasks at work.
(coworker / deadline)

After many years at the company, he decided to send his __________.
(resignation / meeting)

ACTIVITY 3 – MATCH THE SENTENCE WITH THE CORRECT WORD

Write the correct vocabulary word for each definition.

A person who supervises workers and gives instructions. → __________

The money you earn from your job. → __________

A conversation to get a job. → __________

The time limit to finish a task. → __________

A better position at work with more responsibility. → __________

odePagStructure.blockName: HOW TO WRITE A COVER LETTER

odeComponent.htmlView:
A Cover Letter (or covering letter) is a document sent with your CV to introduce yourself and explain why you are the best candidate for a job. At your level, focus on clear, formal communication .

Structure:

Greeting: Dear Hiring Manager / Dear Mr./Ms. [Surname].
Opening: State the position you are applying for.
Body: Highlight 2-3 skills and your motivation [4].
Closing: Express interest in an interview.
Sign-off: Yours sincerely (if you know the name) or Yours faithfully.
Example:

Dear Ms. Smith,

I am writing to apply for the Receptionist position. I have a B1 level of English and two years of experience in customer service. I am hardworking and enjoy working in teams.

I would like to have the opportunity of having a personal interview.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,

[Your Name].

 
Exercises:

Fill in the blanks: Complete the sentence: "I am writing to _______ for the position of Sales Assistant because I have relevant _______."

Writing: Write a short (50-80 words) cover letter for a "Summer Camp Monitor" job using the structure above
